comment: Clean redrawn schematic (CJLectronics, rev 1.1 2005) of the Jen HF Modulator: one-transistor stage with a phase-shift LFO modulating a transistor shunt. No designators; parts listed by quantity.

rows: one input to ground, one in parallel with the 0.01uF from the input pot to ground
one from Q1 emitter, one across the Speed pot
NPN: input stage, modulating transistor, phase-shift oscillator
input-side variable resistor with no value of its own; the nearby 33k label may belong to it
